speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me if the rash appeared immediately after birth or a few days later? Also, is the baby feeding well and does it seem in any pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is the rash spreading rapidly, and do you notice any blisters, pustules, or sores on the baby's skin or mucous membranes? Also, is the baby having difficulty feeding or showing signs of fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis.

REQUEST TEST: VDRL, Darkfield microscopy of lesions, RPR.
REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skin examination showing pustules and rash distribution.
